_about: Codex 5-hour meter points per 1M tokens (100 points = the whole window). cached = input read from cache (charged on Codex, unlike Claude), uncached = input_tokens - cached_input_tokens, output = output_tokens (reasoning included). One-day fits against the meter; astra is about 4x gpt-6.1-sol. An unknown model is priced as `default` and the menu bar says so. codex-pace.mjs rescales all of them by the meter's 1% rises (pace.mjs fillScale).
